label: Create work plan
description: For a substantial, scoped investigation or multi-step assignment, create one concise plan using stable IDs. Ordinary chat and targeted lookups need no plan. Items start pending. If a plan exists, continue it; never replace unfinished work. Repeating the same IDs and titles returns current progress without resetting it; a different plan is rejected.

parameter_descriptions.items: One to ten concrete work items with unique short string IDs and outcome-focused titles. Use these exact IDs for later updates; do not assume numbered or server-generated IDs.
